fields.ourAnswer: I am a fullstack engineer with 8 years of experience building scalable web applications and developer tools. I'm drawn to Linear's mission of creating the best issue tracking platform because I deeply understand the pain points of engineering teams. My background spans both frontend and backend development, with a focus on performance, user experience, and developer ergonomics—qualities that align with Linear's product philosophy. I'm excited to contribute to a product used by thousands of teams and help shape the future of how engineers collaborate.

fields.label: Tell us about a time you had to put your PM hat on to solve a complex product problem.
fields.name: 684eec2a-485d-49f1-9451-c91b9c36df20
fields.ourAnswer: At my previous role, I identified that our core feature had a 40% abandonment rate. Rather than waiting for PM input, I synthesized user research, analyzed usage patterns, and proposed a redesigned workflow. I collaborated with design and engineering to prototype the solution, then presented data-driven recommendations to leadership. We implemented the changes, which increased feature adoption to 78% within two quarters. This experience taught me that great product decisions require balancing user insights, technical constraints, and business metrics—skills I'd bring to Linear.

fields.label: What are you extremely good at? What could you teach the team?
fields.name: 99508347-32a6-4d44-93d4-27e684ddaac5
fields.ourAnswer: I excel at designing scalable product systems and leading cross-functional technical initiatives. With 8 years of experience, I can teach the team best practices in system architecture, technical mentorship, and translating complex engineering challenges into product solutions. I'm particularly strong at building high-performance platforms and fostering collaborative engineering cultures.
